context.body: The petitions widen from disputes to national exile and royal memory.
context.label: Narrative or literary frame

observations.body: Solomon asks for judgment, forgiveness, rain, relief, foreigner inclusion, victory, and return from exile, ending with an appeal for the anointed.
observations.label: Petitions move toward exile and the anointed king: action

observations.body: The prayer anticipates failure and asks that confession and return be heard.
observations.label: Petitions move toward exile and the anointed king: response

payload.posture: Read 2 Chronicles 6:22–42 as ark, prayer, and dedication evidence before carrying it into another source.
payload.tension: The final appeal joins God’s resting place to covenant loyalty without ensuring Israel’s future obedience.
payload.title: Petitions move toward exile and the anointed king
